conceptZh: 露：雨字頭加路，清晨凝在草葉上的小水珠；豬探長衝太快滑過頭，第二次輕輕才找到露珠。
object: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat with an oversized magnifying glass, and a sparkling dewdrop on a blade of grass
morph: the pig overshoots the dewdrop, skids back, and on the second gentle try the glassy droplets settle into the strokes of 露
creativeAngle: 豬探長想用大放大鏡找露珠，衝太猛飛過頭、滑回來，第二次放輕腳步才找到，水珠一顆顆落成露字。
promptEn: An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip on a solid pale morning-sky backdrop of soft cream-blue. Cast: a stout cartoon detective pig in a checked deerstalker hat and a little trench coat, carrying a magnifying glass far too big for him, and one fat sparkling dewdrop sitting on a blade of green grass. The only text on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 露, drawn in saturated deep-teal strokes, ending centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with margins. 0.0-1.5s: the pig trots in with a determined snort, sweeping the magnifying glass left and right and sniffing along the floor like a bloodhound until the grass blade appears at the edge. The first narrated 露 lands as the dewdrop blinks, wobbles, and a teal stroke shimmers above it. 1.5-3.5s: the pig dashes at the dewdrop with way too much power, flies right past it, tumbles over the lens, and slides on his belly across the whole frame with his hat spinning on his snout; the splash of a few tiny drops from the grass flies onto his hat. The second narrated 露 lands as he tiptoes back on the second, gentler try and the dewdrops from the grass slowly drift up and arrange themselves into the strokes of 露 across the center. 3.5-5.0s: through his huge magnifying lens the pig's one giant eye blinks at the glyph, his hat jumps off his head in astonishment, and he catches it on his snout. As the word 露珠 is spoken, a tiny round dewdrop with sparkling eyes rolls down the pig's snout and balances on its tip while he goes cross-eyed. 5.0-8.0s: the glyph is perfectly still and fully readable for the last 3 seconds while the pig proudly polishes the lens with his sleeve, taps his hat in a salute, and the dewdrop on his nose does a tiny shimmy, all away from the strokes. Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin, clear tones, no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 露、露、露珠 (ㄌㄨˋ、ㄌㄨˋ、ㄌㄨˋ ㄓㄨ). The character twice with a short pause, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only. No background music, no extra speech, no subtitles or flashing effects; stylized cartoon animals only, no real people.

conceptZh: 拉布拉多警長吹哨追一顆在草地上亂跳的調皮露珠，連續滑過頭、繞大圈、被自己的腳絆倒，最後飛撲肚皮著地「啪」一聲，噴起的水珠落成上面的雨字頭，煞車的滑痕拉成下面的路，拼出整個露。
object: a runaway sparkling dewdrop bouncing across a lawn of short toy grass, chased by a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog with a star badge and a whistle
morph: the sheriff's belly-flop splats the dewdrop into a fan of droplets that fall and settle as the 雨 top, while his long skid tracks across the grass stiffen into the 路 half below, completing 露
creativeAngle: 上一版是豬探長慢慢找露珠、水珠自己飄成字，動作小又安靜。這版換成警長主角、全程追逐：露珠是會跑的小目標，警長每次衝過頭都更誇張，最後一記飛撲才讓「撞擊本身」造字——噴水成雨、滑痕成路，字的上下結構直接對應兩個物理結果。詞選最安全的「露水」，講到時警長甩毛噴出一排小水珠落在草上，聽到就看到。
promptEn:
An 8-second bright, clean toy-animation clip. Backdrop: a flat pale mint-cream sky over a low strip of short soft toy grass, nothing else behind. Cast: a big friendly cartoon Labrador sheriff dog, golden plush fur, a shiny star badge on a little vest, a whistle on a cord, eager and clumsy; and one runaway sparkling dewdrop the size of a tennis ball, glossy and clear with two tiny dot eyes. The only text ever on screen is the single Traditional Chinese glyph 露 in saturated deep-blue strokes, finishing centered, uncropped, about 70 percent of frame height with even margins.

0.0-1.5s: the dewdrop sits on a grass tip, then boings away to the right. The sheriff spots it, eyes go wide, he blows a puffy little whistle toot, points a paw at it, and digs in his back legs to charge. The first narrated 露 lands right as the dewdrop makes its first bounce and a faint blue stroke-shaped glint flashes above it.

1.5-3.5s: the chase. The sheriff rockets left-to-right, overshoots, skids straight past the dewdrop with all four paws locked and ears flying back. The dewdrop zips the other way. He wheels around in a bigger loop, skids past again, then trips over his own front paws and tumbles in a somersault, badge spinning. The dewdrop hops onto his nose for a split second and bounces off, mocking him.

3.5-5.0s: freeze for half a beat, the sheriff crouched low, wiggling his rump, tongue out. Then the flying leap: he launches in a big arc across the frame and belly-flops SPLAT on the dewdrop. Cartoon squash-and-stretch, a comic wobble, a dazed grin. The impact squirts the dewdrop into a fan of droplets that pop up and fall back down, settling as the 雨 top of the glyph, while his long dark skid tracks across the grass stiffen and straighten into the 路 half below. The second narrated 露 lands exactly as the last droplet and the last skid line snap into place and the whole 露 locks solid.

5.0-8.0s: the glyph stays perfectly still and fully readable for the final 3 seconds. The sheriff staggers up beside it, dizzy and happy, and gives one big wet full-body shake. As the word 露水 is spoken, a neat spray of little dewdrops flies off his fur and lands sparkling on the grass blades in the lower corner, well away from the strokes. He then tips his badge proudly, tail wagging, and sits down with a satisfied huff.

Audio: a warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks slowly and distinctly in clear Taiwanese Mandarin with clear tones and no erhua, reading exactly these syllables: 露、露、露水 (ㄌㄨˋ、ㄌㄨˋ、ㄌㄨˋ ㄕㄨㄟˇ). The character twice with a short pause between, then the word once, then stop. The word is audio only, no subtitles. Soft cartoon sound effects only, quieter than the voice, no music. Stylized cartoon animal only, no real people, no watermark, no flashing effects.
